newsitem.title: USA: Starwood Lodging plans share repurchase.
newsitem.headline: Starwood Lodging plans share repurchase.

text.p: Starwood Lodging Trust, whose stock is traded as paired shares with Starwood Lodging Corp, said Thursday it was going to buy back up to 1.5 million of the shares.
The repurchases will be made in the open market, it said.
The trust also said it was working with institutional lenders to arrange new credit facilities for up to $700 million.
The facilities would consolidate and replace the trust's existing credit facilities and provide funding for future acquisitions, it said.
The trust operates as a real estate investment trust and conducts business as general partner of SLT Realty LP.

Starwood Lodging Corp is a hotel management and operating company that carries on business as managing general partner of SLC Operating LP, which leases properties from the trust and operates them directly or through other management companies.
